name: AWS Activate
what_you_get: Up to $200,000 in AWS Activate credits, tiered by funding stage.
how_to_get_it: Apply at aws.amazon.com/startups/credits.
requirements: Pre-Series B, founded in the last 10 years, AWS account on a paid tier plan.
catch: Approval needed; amount depends on stage.
title: Up to $200,000 in credits; the Founders tier is up to $5,000

name: AWS Free Tier
what_you_get: $100 credits on signup plus up to $100 more for trying key services.
how_to_get_it: Create a new AWS account on the Free plan at aws.amazon.com/free.
catch: Free plan is limited to select services and closes after 6 months or when credits run out unless you upgrade to Paid.
title: Up to $200 in AWS credits for new accounts
expires: Credits usable up to 6 months after account creation

name: Cloudflare for Startups
what_you_get: Up to $350,000 in credits for a year; entry tier is $10,000, plus core security features free.
how_to_get_it: Apply at cloudflare.com/forstartups.
requirements: Entry tier: bootstrapped or self-funded, under $1M raised.
catch: Approval needed; higher tiers need more funding.
title: Up to $350,000 in credits; the entry tier is $10,000

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
what_you_get: 10,000 Neurons a day of Workers AI inference.
how_to_get_it: Use Workers AI on the Workers Free plan.
catch: Requests fail past the daily cap; some models need paid billing.
title: 10,000 Neurons a day of AI inference

name: Datadog for Startups
what_you_get: A year of Datadog Pro, up to $100,000 in credits.
how_to_get_it: Apply at datadoghq.com/partner/datadog-for-startups.
requirements: Series A or earlier, new to Datadog, referred by an official partner.
catch: Partner referral required; credits last one year.
title: A year of Datadog, up to $100,000 in credits

name: Deepgram
what_you_get: $200 in free API credit, then pay as you go.
how_to_get_it: Sign up at deepgram.com.
catch: Not stated by vendor
title: $200 in free speech API credit

name: ElevenLabs
what_you_get: 10,000 credits a month for text to speech and other audio tools.
how_to_get_it: Sign up at elevenlabs.io.
catch: No commercial license on Free (it starts on the Starter plan); unused credits do not roll over.
title: 10,000 free voice credits every month

name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
what_you_get: 33,000,000 characters (over 680 hours of Agents), 12 months of free platform access.
how_to_get_it: Apply at elevenlabs.io/startup-grants.
requirements: A monetized product use case; agencies, consultancies and SMBs are not eligible; one application per company.
catch: Approval needed; existing enterprise customers excluded.
title: 33,000,000 characters (ElevenLabs says "$5,500+ in value", about 680 hours of Agents)

name: Gemini CLI
what_you_get: 1,000 requests per user per day.
how_to_get_it: Install Gemini CLI and log in with Google.
catch: Not stated by vendor
title: 1,000 coding-agent requests a day

name: Google AI Pro via Jio
what_you_get: Up to 18 months of Google AI Pro (₹35,100 value), including Gemini 4 Argon in the Gemini app and AI Mode.
how_to_get_it: Claim it in MyJio or on jio.com and link your Google account.
requirements: A Jio SIM, age 18+, and an active unlimited 5G plan of ₹349 or more kept for the whole period. No card to Google.
catch: India and Jio only, and the paid Jio plan is the price of entry. Gemini 4 Argon is not in AI Studio or the API on Pro.
title: Up to 18 months of Google AI Pro free for Jio users in India

name: Google for Startups Cloud
what_you_get: $2,000 in credits for pre-funded startups; $200,000 (up to $350,000 for AI-first) for Seed to Series A.
how_to_get_it: Apply to the Google for Startups Cloud Program.
requirements: Startup status; larger amounts need Seed to Series A funding.
catch: Approval needed.
title: $2,000 for pre-funded startups; $200,000–$350,000 for Seed to Series A

name: Google Vids
what_you_get: Free HD video generation with Gemini in Google Vids.
how_to_get_it: Open Google Vids with a Google Account.
catch: Personal accounts get 50 credits a month that do not roll over, and AI video clips and avatars share a 6-a-month cap; video generation starts on desktop at vids.new.
title: Free AI video generation for any Google account

name: Kit (ConvertKit)
what_you_get: Free plan for up to 10,000 subscribers with unlimited landing pages, forms and broadcasts.
how_to_get_it: Try Kit for free at kit.com.
catch: Not stated by vendor
title: A free newsletter plan for up to 10,000 subscribers

name: Microsoft for Startups
what_you_get: Up to $150,000 in Azure credits plus AI models and developer tools.
how_to_get_it: Apply at microsoft.com/en-us/startups.
catch: Credits apply only to eligible Azure services.
title: Up to $150,000 in credits, plus AI models and developer tools

name: MongoDB for Startups
what_you_get: Atlas credits (amount not shown) and 30 days of free Developer Support.
how_to_get_it: Apply at mongodb.com/startups.
requirements: Under 7 years old, Series A or earlier, single software product; no dev shops or agencies.
catch: Approval needed; credit amount not disclosed.
title: Atlas credits (the amount isn't shown on the page)

name: Notion for Startups
what_you_get: Business plan with Notion AI free for up to 6 months.
how_to_get_it: Unlock the startup offer at notion.com/startups.
requirements: Non-paying Notion customer, under 100 employees; 6 months needs a partner affiliation; 3 months needs a business website and company email.
catch: Length depends on eligibility; approval needed.
title: Business plan free for up to 6 months (Notion says "save $12,000")

name: OpenCode
what_you_get: $0 access to free models such as Cat Jam Free, Step 5 Preview Free, LongCat 2.5 Preview Free, Big Pickle and Space Bunny Free.
how_to_get_it: Sign up for OpenCode Console and pick a free model.
requirements: An OpenCode Console account; sign-up asks for billing or credits.
catch: Marked limited time with no end date, and some free models use your data for training.
title: Free models on OpenCode Console
expires: Limited time; no end date stated

name: PostHog for Startups
what_you_get: $50,000 in PostHog credits for 12 months plus $12,000 in partner perks.
how_to_get_it: Create a PostHog account, then apply.
catch: Credits last 12 months; approval needed.
title: $50,000 in PostHog credits for 12 months, plus $12,000 in partner perks

name: Runable for Startups
what_you_get: $5,000 in Runable credits.
how_to_get_it: Apply at runable.com/programs/for-startups; a human reviews within 48 hours.
requirements: Company details, incorporation date and funding stage.
catch: Approval needed.
title: $5,000 in credits

name: Runway
what_you_get: 125 one-time credits, a selection of generative models, and 5 GB asset storage.
how_to_get_it: Start free at runwayml.com.
catch: Credits are one-time and do not renew.
title: 125 one-time free credits for AI video

name: Stripe Atlas
what_you_get: $2,500 in Stripe credits for the first year plus $50,000+ in partner discounts.
how_to_get_it: Incorporate with Stripe Atlas.
catch: Atlas has a fee, refunded only if you deposit $5,000 into Stripe Treasury within 90 days.
title: $2,500 in Stripe credits plus $50,000+ in partner discounts

name: Vercel AI Gateway
what_you_get: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning at $0 per token through AI Gateway (model id nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free).
how_to_get_it: Select nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free in AI Gateway from your Vercel account, or point Claude Code, Cursor or Codex at it.
catch: Runs on an NVIDIA trial endpoint where prompts are logged; do not send confidential data.
title: Free Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on AI Gateway

name: Vercel for Startups
what_you_get: Up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, Enterprise-tier access and startup support.
how_to_get_it: Apply at vercel.com/startups.
requirements: Eligibility criteria are not detailed on the page.
catch: Approval needed.
title: Up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, plus Enterprise-tier access
